start: Admin app, Messages & offers, 40 app members

steps.action: Write a title and a note, send to everyone now
user_sees: The message at the top of the Sent list, seen by 0 of 40
must_not: Recipients counted with members who left

steps.action: Ten members open their inbox
user_sees: The Sent list shows seen by 10 of 40
must_not: Seen counted from members who joined after the message

start: Admin app, Messages & offers, picking a group

steps.action: Send to a chosen group of 5 members, set to appear tomorrow 7 am
user_sees: The Sent list shows the time it goes and that it went to a group, seen by 0 of 5
must_not: Members outside the group getting it

steps.action: Next day after 7 am, 3 of the group read it
user_sees: Seen by 3 of 5
must_not: The message shown before 7 am

steps.action: Send with an empty title, a 61-letter title or a 301-letter note
user_sees: A refusal naming the problem
must_not: A cut-down message sent

steps.action: Send a second offer or event the same day
user_sees: 'You already sent an offer or event today. Members get at most one a day in the app. Send it tomorrow, or on WhatsApp now.'
must_not: A second offer reaching members that day

steps.action: Send to a group of members who all left
user_sees: A refusal that no one is in the group
must_not: A message sent to nobody shown as sent

start: Admin app, Sent list with a message sent 2 minutes ago

steps.action: Tap 'Take back' on it
user_sees: Question 'Take back “<title>”? It is removed from every member’s inbox.'
The message marked taken back
must_not: The message still in members' inboxes

steps.action: Send another offer the same day
user_sees: The send allowed, since the first was taken back within 10 minutes
must_not: The taken-back message counted against the one-a-day limit

start: Admin app, a group message to 3 members

steps.action: A member outside the group opens the inbox
user_sees: Only messages meant for them
must_not: The group message's text shown to a member outside the group

steps.action: The front desk opens Messages
user_sees: The Sent list, no Send
must_not: The front desk able to send to members

start: Admin app, front desk signed in, Messages & offers

steps.action: Open the Sent list
user_sees: Every message of the gym with seen by x of y
must_not: Messages of another gym

start: Admin app, front desk signed in

steps.action: Try to send a message or take one back
user_sees: A refusal that only the owner can
must_not: The message sent or taken back by the desk

start: Admin app, front desk, a message the owner just took back

steps.action: Refresh the Sent list
user_sees: The message marked taken back
must_not: It still shown as live

start: Member app, two unread messages from the gym

steps.action: Open the gym inbox
user_sees: Both messages, newest first, marked unread
must_not: Messages of another gym

steps.action: Open them
user_sees: Unread count goes to 0
must_not: Seen marks for messages the member cannot see

start: Member app, the gym set a message to appear at 7 am tomorrow and sent another to a group the member is in

steps.action: Open the inbox tonight
user_sees: The group message only
must_not: The 7 am message shown early

steps.action: Open it after 7 am
user_sees: Both messages, the timed one dated 7 am
must_not: The timed one dated when it was written

start: Member app with a changed or broken app sending wrong ids

steps.action: Mark as seen a message of another gym, a timed one not yet due, and 101 ids at once
user_sees: Nothing marked for the first two; the 101 refused
must_not: A seen mark that raises another gym's count

start: Member app, a message already read

steps.action: The gym takes it back; open the inbox
user_sees: The message gone
must_not: A taken-back message still shown

start: Member app, joined the gym today

steps.action: Open the inbox
user_sees: Messages from the last 14 days before joining and after
must_not: Older messages
Group messages meant for others
